Who we are

A unique and caring service, for every family.

Our aim

We are committed to providing a unique and caring service offering to all clients and families.

Our mission

To deliver professional funeral services that give families comfort and peace of mind, by entrusting us to assist in conducting the last rights for loved ones.

Our vision

To be a leader in cost effective and tailor made funeral services.

Our work

The day, set out the way the family pictured it.

Tents, carpet, lawn, chairs and flowers in our colours, and the office where families sit down with us.

Since 2015

Serving families in Johannesburg and out to the family home, wherever the burial takes place.

Services

Everything the day needs, carried by one team.

From the first phone call to the last chair packed away, the family makes the decisions and we handle the rest.

01

24 hour collection and mortuary care

We collect from the home, the hospital or the state mortuary, at any hour, and care for your loved one until the day of the funeral.

Any hour
02

Arrangements and paperwork

Death registration, the BI-1663, burial order and cemetery booking. We sit with the family and complete it together.

Home visit
03

Coffins and caskets

A range from a dignified standard coffin through to a solid casket, shown to you before anything is decided.

Choice of range
04

Hearse and family transport

Our hearse and family bus, so relatives travel together from the service to the cemetery.

Own fleet
05

Tent, chairs, carpet and décor

Stretch tent, artificial lawn, red carpet, chairs and covers, flowers and draping, set out early on the morning.

Set out by us
06

Programmes, doves and the small touches

Printed programmes, a dove release at the graveside, and the details that make the service feel like the person.

On request
07

Repatriation

Transport to the family home in another province when the burial is not in Johannesburg.

Countrywide
08

Tombstones and unveilings

Granite headstones and full graves, cut, engraved and installed, and the unveiling arranged with the family.
